label: Parts stolen
description: A catalytic converter, wheels or another part was taken.

damage_closeup.title: Where the part was taken
damage_closeup.instructions: Photograph the spot the part was cut or removed, for example under the car.

damage_wide.title: The car from the side
damage_wide.instructions: Step back so the whole side of the car is in the photo.

documents.instructions: Take a photo of the police report slip, if you have one.
